purpose: One fresh read-only metadata census of fixed immediate-child SDK shards; no capacity recovery or qualification.
approval_context: User requested the next sharded census, was asked to choose global versus per-shard limits, delegated the choice ('jeta bhalo hoy oita kor'), was told the selected one-million-node aggregate maximum, and asked to resume. No cleanup or cap increase beyond these bounds is authorized.

target.shard_definition: Each immediate SDK child is one fixed shard, including its root node and descendants. A regular file or symlink is a one-node leaf shard; never open/follow leaf payloads. No adaptive resharding.
target.host_premise: Trusted fresh disposable GitHub Ubuntu VM without concurrent writers; not a proven concurrency-exclusion claim.
target.boundary_checks: Descriptor-relative O_NOFOLLOW opening; reject SDK/descendant mounts, cross-device nodes, hardlinked regular files, special types and identity changes; re-list directories and SDK root before completion.

limits.count_semantics: Node caps bound accepted distinct entries, not total OS metadata syscalls or directory-listing entries. Re-list and identity checks repeat; one rejected boundary observation may be needed. Name-byte totals count accepted full relative paths, not peak RAM.

execution.required_runtime: CPython 3.12 Linux x86_64 root, main thread
execution.local_tests: Owned synthetic temporary directories and mocked runtime/target/audit/timer boundaries only.

result_semantics.observed_budget_hit: Successful limit localization; incomplete census. No automatic further scan or cleanup.
result_semantics.observed_census_complete: All bounded metadata shards completed with directory re-list, identity and mount checks; does not prove reclaimable disk or authorize deletion.
